markdown:
- Northbridge Borough Council: the Cabinet agreed on 26 February 2025 that weekly collections of food waste would begin in April 2026 [Source 1], and members noted that the cost of the new service would be met from the capital programme [Source 1].
- Eastmere District Council: the Council resolved on 4 March 2025 to keep fortnightly collections of general waste [Source 2], and an amendment to bring in a charge for garden waste was lost [Source 2].
- Northbridge Borough Council: the Overview and Scrutiny Committee heard on 11 March 2025 that the recycling rate had fallen to 34 per cent [Source 3].
